lines.line: Dehleez pe mere dil ki joh rakhe hai tune kadam
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: Dehleez (Threshold) | pe (on) | mere (my) | dil (heart) | ki (of) | joh (which/when) | rakhe hai (have placed) | tune (you) | kadam (step/feet)
Literal translation: "The step which you have placed on the threshold of my heart"
Translation: "Ever since you stepped onto the threshold of my heart"

lines.line: Tere naam pe meri zindagi likh di mere humdum
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: Tere (Your) | naam (name) | pe (on) | meri (my) | zindagi (life) | likh di (have written) | mere (my) | humdum (beloved/companion)
Literal translation: "In your name I have written my life, my companion"
Translation: "I've dedicated my entire life to your name, my love"

lines.line: Haan seekha maine jeena jeena kaise jeena
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: Haan (Yes) | seekha (learned) | maine (I) | jeena (living) | jeena (living) | kaise (how) | jeena (to live)
Literal translation: "Yes I learned living, living, how to live"
Translation: "Yes, I finally learned how to truly live life"

lines.line: Haan seekha maine jeena mere humdum
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: Haan (Yes) | seekha (learned) | maine (I) | jeena (living) | mere (my) | humdum (beloved)
Literal translation: "Yes I learned living, my beloved"
Translation: "Yes, I learned how to live, my beloved"

lines.line: Na seekha kabhi jeena jeena kaise jeena
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: Na (Not) | seekha (learned) | kabhi (ever) | jeena (living) | jeena (living) | kaise (how) | jeena (to live)
Literal translation: "Never learned living, living, how to live"
Translation: "I had never known how to live before"

lines.line: Na seekha jeena tere bina humdum
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: Na (Not) | seekha (learned) | jeena (living) | tere (you) | bina (without) | humdum (beloved)
Literal translation: "Not learned living without you, beloved"
Translation: "I never learned how to live without you, my love"
Word-by-word breakdown into English: Sachi (True) | si (like/quite) | hai (are) | yeh (these) | tareefein (compliments/praises)
Literal translation: "These compliments are quite genuine"
Translation: "Every word of praise I offer you is genuine"

lines.line: Dil se joh maine kari hai
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: Dil (Heart) | se (from) | joh (which) | maine (I) | kari hai (have made)
Literal translation: "Which I have made from the heart"
Translation: "Because it comes straight from my heart"

lines.line: Joh tu mila toh saji hai duniya meri humdum
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: Joh (When/Since) | tu (you) | mila (met/found) | toh (then) | saji hai (is decorated) | duniya (world) | meri (my) | humdum (beloved)
Literal translation: "When you were found, then my world got decorated, my companion"
Translation: "Ever since you came into my life, my world has blossomed, my love"

lines.line: O aasman mila zameen ko meri aadhe aadhe poore hai hum
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: O (Oh) | aasman (sky) | mila (met/found) | zameen (earth) | ko (to) | meri (my) | aadhe (half) | aadhe (half) | poore (complete) | hai (are) | hum (we)
Literal translation: "The sky met my earth, half half we are complete"
Translation: "My earth has finally met its sky, and two halves have become whole"
